name: Style Thief (Martialist Archetype)
body:
By fusing different martial styles together, a style thief can create devastating combinations, though the art requires dedication and focus that reduces his flexibility in other areas. If he sees someone use a style of martial arts, he can copy it for a short time.

Style Focus (Su)

This class feature, gained at 4th level, works as inner focus with the following differences. Instead of the normal ki abilities, the style thief gains the ability to change styles as a free action by spending a ki point, and may spend a ki point as a swift action to gain the benefit of one style feat from the active style of a creature he can see. This benefit lasts until he changes styles, combat ends, or he spends a ki point to copy another style.

At 8th level, he gains the ability to spend a ki point as an immediate action to negate any effects one style feat would have on him or any bonuses a creature gains against him from one style feat.

At 16th level, the style thief can spend 3 ki points to gain the benefit of up to 3 style feats from the active style of a creature he can see.

This bonus lasts until he changes styles or combat ends.

Memory of Form (Ex)

At 5th level, the style thief can choose to remember one style feat he has copied using style focus. He may pay a ki point to copy that feat using style focus as though it was being used by a creature he could see. The style thief may remember this feat until he chooses to forget it in place of another one he has copied. The style thief may remember 1 additional style feat for every 5 levels they gain beyond 5th.

This replaces the fortuitous spirit class feature.
